display.purpose: Home screen title only. One instance per session.

headline.purpose: Settings page title. One per screen maximum.

label.purpose: Navigation chrome, game-state readouts, all button text. Uppercase + wide tracking.

shadows.name: proximity-glow
shadows.purpose: Game board only. Intensity driven by proximity to nearest mine. Not a design token; a game mechanic in CSS.

shadows.name: danger-glow
shadows.purpose: Game board when run has failed or level is exploded.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Color state changes on cells, button border shifts. Fast and invisible.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: New Run, Start. The primary call to action. Full-width on mobile home screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: block; width: 100%; background: #34d399; color: #000000; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 20px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 75ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6ee7b7; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #34d399; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Resume Button
components.description: Resume Run. Ghost of the primary; used only when an active run exists.
components.css: .ds-btn-resume { display: block; width: 100%; background: transparent; color: #6ee7b7; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.6); border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 20px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 75ms ease-out, border-color 75ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-resume:hover { background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.10); } .ds-btn-resume:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #34d399; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Back, Settings, Restart. Navigation chrome. Recedes behind primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #a1a1aa; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 75ms ease-out, color 75ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #3f3f46; color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #34d399; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Reset all data. Full-width, isolated at the bottom of Settings.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: block; width: 100%; background: transparent; color: #f87171; border: 1px solid rgba(127, 29, 29, 0.6); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 75ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: rgba(69, 10, 10, 0.30); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f87171; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Setting Toggle
components.description: Labeled toggle row with native checkbox. Used in the Settings screen.
components.css: .ds-setting-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.4); border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-setting-toggle__text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-setting-toggle__label { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-setting-toggle__desc { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #71717a; } .ds-setting-toggle__check { width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: #34d399; cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Stat Display Row
components.description: 3-cell readout strip. Shown only when an active run exists. Not shown when there is no run.
components.html:
3Level
7Best
2Explosions
components.css: .ds-stat-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; } .ds-stat-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; background: rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.6); border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 8px; text-align: center; } .ds-stat-cell__num { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: #f4f4f5; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat-cell--active .ds-stat-cell__num { color: #6ee7b7; } .ds-stat-cell__label { margin-top: 4px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #71717a; }

components.name: Game Header
components.description: Slim border-bottom bar with back button, centered readout, and restart button.
components.html: Lv 32/6 marked
components.css: .ds-game-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; background: #090909; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(39, 39, 42, 0.7); padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-game-header__info { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-game-header__level { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #6ee7b7; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-game-header__marks { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #71717a; }

narrative.overview:
BlindSweeper is played in effective darkness. The board is pure black during play; you cannot see what you are looking for. Every surface, every label, every button should feel like it belongs to that darkness rather than sitting on top of it. The UI is not a frame around the game; it is the game's outermost layer.

The visual approach is immersive restraint. Surfaces grade from void (pure black, the board) to near-void (depth-0, depth-1) to barely raised (surface-raised). The single accent color, Cleared Signal, is reserved for exactly what the name implies: states and actions the player knows are safe. Everything else is graded zinc and near-black.

This system explicitly refuses the conventions of polished SaaS dashboards and casual mobile games. The design should feel like holding something heavy in a dark room. Calm, precise, slightly tense.
keyCharacteristics: Four-grade depth stack: board void (#000) > page void (#050505) > header dark (#090909) > raised surface (#18181b)
One accent color (Cleared Signal, emerald) used at under 10% surface coverage
Type is functional, never decorative: labels are facts
Motion is state-only: transitions respond to interaction, never perform on load
The board dominates the game screen; all chrome exists to orient, not to compete

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cleared Signal (#34d399) is used only for confirmed-safe states: active run, primary CTA, marked cells, the primary action button. Forbidden as decorative color. Its rarity is its meaning.

rules.name: The Board Void Rule
rules.body: #000000 belongs to the game board. Page surfaces use #050505. The board must read deeper than everything around it.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If a UI element appears to float, cast a shadow, or sit above its surface, it is wrong. Separation is achieved by background value. Shadows are game feedback, not interface decoration.

rules.name: The Uppercase Budget Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + wide tracking (letter-spacing >= 0.08em) is reserved for navigation chrome and game-state labels. Maximum two uppercase label elements per screen.

rules.name: The No-Blank-Stats Rule
rules.body: The stat row is hidden when there is no run. Empty metric tiles with dashes are a SaaS pattern. Prohibited.

dos: Do use #050505 for page backgrounds and #000000 only for the game board.
Do use Cleared Signal (#34d399) exclusively for confirmed-safe and active states.
Do use Ghost buttons for all navigation chrome. They should recede behind primary actions.
Do hide the stat display entirely when there is no run.
Do keep all buttons at 4px radius.
Do use uppercase + wide tracking only for navigation labels and game-state readouts.
Do suppress all transitions when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is set.
donts: Don't use card grids, sidebar navigation, metric tiles with gradient accents, or SaaS dashboard patterns.
Don't use bouncy animations, entrance choreography, star rewards, or casual mobile game conventions.
Don't use neon-on-black, purple-to-cyan gradients, or RGB gaming aesthetics.
Don't use true black (#000000) on page surfaces outside the game board.
Don't add shadows to UI chrome elements. The Flat-By-Default Rule is absolute.
Don't use Cleared Signal as a decorative accent or hover indicator on neutral elements.
Don't show dashes or zeros in the stat display when there is no active run.
Don't soften the design with large border radii, warm neutrals, or playful copy.
